title: Droids on All Sides
front_description: Now astride the reek, Anakin, Padmé and Obi-Wan are soon contained by droidekas, which roll to the center of the arena, transform and surround Dooku's defiant captives. "1his isn't how it's supposed to be!" shouts a flustered Nute Gunray in the archducal box. Also unexpected is the arrival of Mace Windu, who ignites his lightsaber and holds it to Jango Fett's neck. Count Dooku turns to see the great Jedi standing behind him, and masks his surprise elegantly.
back_description: Before a blue screen, Hayden Christensen, Natalie Portman and Ewan McGregor ride high.
